source_preparation.scope: All corpus documents, full title/text, neutral handles and literal roles. Native document IDs stay in the offline map. No query, qrel, ranking or model run. Future query/arm isolation and scoring must be declared separately.

source_audit.scope: Actual public Store snapshot joined to released corpus by retained capture receipts; direct literal equality, no digest or automatic operation labels.

input_boundary: All released documents are in the common initial source Store. Query and instruction only enter the registered retrieval tool. Qrels and source-to-native-ID map remain evaluator-side.

query_protocol.cohort: Every row in the selected release queries.jsonl, in release order; no sampling/limit option.
query_protocol.initial_state: Fresh complete Store copy per query. Method templates retain the source namespace/IDs while declaring their own config/source version. Native model pool stays warm across copies.
query_protocol.outputs: Actual ToolMessage plus retained query Store. Primary failed calls get empty rankings; known provider failures with no new unknown usage can advance to untouched cases. Other first failures stop; no retry/resume/answer repair.
query_protocol.archive: Every closed case is losslessly archived as tar.gz after checking file names/sizes; only its redundant working copy is removed. Raw databases, results, traces and inputs remain recoverable.
query_protocol.ranking: First occurrence in the actual ToolMessage material/node/citation order. Original range selects its one corpus document; a view selects only explicitly cited nodes, never unused bindings or internal search candidates. Reciprocal rank values encode order, not confidence.
query_protocol.qualification: View citation ranking is not proof that the original body reached the Reader. Returned-list length is constrained by the declared tool budget; reporting native cutoffs does not imply1000returned documents.
query_protocol.scoring: Separate score_host_intent_instructir.py loads qrels after retrieval; native metric wrapper keeps missing/empty rankings in full denominators and marks incomplete cohorts.

cost_protocol: Original ledger only. Query wall includes runtime setup/retrieval, excludes experimental reset/archive. Orchestration plus query CPU not already charged by nested compute phases is pending after closure; nested query/driver wall and CPU are not summed twice.
first_failures: Retained; synthetic fixture had v1/event-delta mismatch before correction toI2. No production boundary or output was weakened.
remaining: Freeze final method/common resource configuration before full9906-query evaluation
